# Rails Agent Skills

> A curated library of 41 executable skills and 9 workflows that teach AI coding tools how to plan, test, implement, document, and review Rails work using production-minded conventions.

Rails Agent Skills provides structured SKILL.md files that give coding agents the context, conventions, and discipline to generate production-quality Rails code. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf.

## Core principles

- **Tests gate implementation** — Agents cannot write implementation code until the test exists, runs, and fails for the right reason
- **Workflow chaining** — Skills name the next skill to load in their Integration table. Skills are building blocks; workflows are the value
- **Atomic** — One skill per concern. No monolithic guides
- **Gated** — Hard gates enforce discipline at every checkpoint

## Skill categories (41 skills)

- **Planning**: create-prd, generate-tasks, plan-tickets
- **Testing**: plan-tests, write-tests, test-service, triage-bug
- **Code Quality**: code-review, security-check, refactor-code, apply-code-conventions, apply-stack-conventions
- **Architecture & DDD**: define-domain-language, review-domain-boundaries, model-domain, review-architecture
- **Rails Implementation**: create-service-object, implement-background-job, implement-authorization, implement-hotwire
- **APIs & Engines**: implement-graphql, integrate-api-client, version-api, create-engine, test-engine

## Workflows (9 callable)

- tdd — Full TDD feature cycle
- quality — Pre-PR quality check
- review — Systematic PR review
- engine — Engine development loop
- bug-fix — Bug triage and fix
- graphql — GraphQL feature development
- migration — Safe migration workflow
- background-job — Background job implementation
- setup — New project onboarding

## Integration paths

1. **MCP Server** — Agent discovers skills via `list_skills` and loads them on demand via `use_skill`
2. **Chat Commands** — Force the agent to use a specific skill (prepend with `@` in Cursor/Windsurf)
3. **GitHub CLI** — `gh skill install igmarin/rails-agent-skills`
